title: Overpressure Blast Effects Analysis Burden Reducing Clarification
summary: Transportation Department, Federal Aviation Administration — Proposed Rule — FAA proposes to amend its commercial space launch and reentry licensing regulations to streamline the licensing process and reduce regulatory burden for license applicants. Specifically, FAA proposes to amend the regulations to state that a far-field overpressure blast effects analysis required for license applicants does not need to account for members of the public in hypothetical locations.

title: Lightning Hazard Mitigation Burden-Reducing Exception
summary: Transportation Department, Federal Aviation Administration — Proposed Rule — FAA proposes to amend its commercial space launch and reentry licensing regulations to streamline the licensing process and reduce regulatory burden for license applicants. Specifically, FAA proposes to add an exception for compliance with lightning hazard mitigation requirements for certain licensed launch and reentry operations.

title: Streamlining Flight Safety Analysis Methodology Means of Compliance
summary: Transportation Department, Federal Aviation Administration — Proposed Rule — FAA proposes to amend its commercial space launch and reentry licensing regulations to streamline the licensing process. Specifically, FAA proposes to alleviate regulatory burden for license applicants by consolidating information required for an operator's flight safety analysis.

title: Digital Modernization for Licensing Electronic Application Submissions
summary: Transportation Department, Federal Aviation Administration — Proposed Rule — FAA proposes to amend its commercial space launch and reentry licensing regulations to allow for submission of license and permit applications and requests for waivers, alternative time frames, and safety element approvals through additional electronic methods.

title: Simplifying Physical Containment Requirements
summary: Transportation Department, Federal Aviation Administration — Proposed Rule — FAA proposes to amend its commercial space launch and reentry licensing regulations to streamline the licensing process and reduce regulatory burden on operators. Specifically, FAA proposes to relieve the burden by specifying that, when using physical containment as a hazard control strategy, operators do not need to develop flight hazard areas in accordance with FAA's existing flight hazard area analysis requirements.
